verdict.rationale: Claude is itself an AI assistant/agent, so it occupies the MCP client role. All MCP evidence, including custom connectors to remote MCP servers and installing local MCP servers in Claude Desktop, describes Claude connecting to MCP servers, not serving tools to other agents. The probe's 'official MCP server' label points to that same client-side connectors page. Nothing shows Claude itself running as an MCP server, so the server axis does not apply.
